metadata.title: Clicked like I was chasing a fly and somehow got the only kill? Valorant aim is cursed
metadata.description:
Me: flailing wildly like my mouse is possessed
Enemy: probably rethinking their life choices
How did that even hit? No clue but I’m cashing in
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, this one’s for you

Tap in if your aim surprises even you!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
